name: The Westin Anaheim Resort
insider_take: This towering modern oasis sits just steps from Disneyland's magic, offering sophisticated luxury in the heart of theme park territory.
whats_special: The Westin Anaheim Resort stands as the tallest hotel in the Anaheim Resort District at 15 stories, featuring stunning views of Disneyland's nightly fireworks from select rooms. The hotel's unique location offers direct pedestrian access to the Disneyland Resort via a dedicated walkway, making it one of the most convenient luxury stays for Disney visitors. The property also houses Tangaroa Terrace, a Polynesian-themed restaurant that's a local favorite beyond just hotel guests.
pro_tip: Book a Fireworks View room on floors 10-15 facing northeast for prime Disneyland fireworks viewing without the crowds - you'll get a private nightly show from your balcony.
dont_miss: The hotel's rooftop pool deck offers panoramic views of the Santa Ana Mountains and Orange County skyline. Take advantage of the complimentary shuttle to nearby Knott's Berry Farm, and explore the historic Anaheim Packing District just 10 minutes away - a converted citrus packing house turned trendy food hall that locals love but many tourists overlook.
pros: Prime location directly across from Disneyland Resort main entrance
Signature Westin Heavenly Beds and premium spa-inspired amenities
Modern wellness-focused facilities including WestinWORKOUT fitness studio
Multiple dining options including rooftop lounge with theme park views
cons: Premium pricing due to Disney proximity and luxury positioning
High-traffic tourist area with frequent crowds
